finding.statement: The just-fused CLAY_FORGE_EXECUTION_REPLAY_IDENTITY/v1 still included delta_id even though delta_id identifies the evaluation/candidate envelope rather than measured execution. A same-execution re-emission could therefore change only delta_id and obtain a different replay key. The existing 8.73 regression covered timestamp and candidate narration mutations but not delta_id-only replay.
finding.supervisor_alignment: SUPERVISOR_STEERING_8_73 requires replay identity to derive from stable measured execution evidence and requires semantic replay to mint zero packets/tokens.

hypothesis: A replay-v2 identity that excludes delta_id, while preserving a v1 provenance hash and backfilling v2 from persisted packet evidence, closes envelope-only replay without losing upgrade safety.
counterhypothesis: delta_id is part of execution identity and therefore must remain in the replay key.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_SEMANTICS: delta_id is carried in the evaluation packet as envelope provenance, while stable execution identity is already independently bound by source/evaluation heads, worker, targets, provider/model/role, execution-admission digest and metric identity.
